label: For every NORM_ON_CLAIMS_3 and every claim in its scope that fails its standard: if the norm holds…
paraphrase: For every norm on claims (a scope and a standard, relative to an acceptance predicate) and every claim in its scope that fails its standard: if the norm holds, that claim is not acceptable (horn 1); if the claim is acceptable, it is a counterexample to the norm (horn 2). A theorem of logic about the schema; no particular norm is assumed.
